job: Change the tone or length of a piece of text.
purpose: Small text helpers: muted, faint and second-step colours (fd-muted, fd-faint, fd-text-2), status text colours, a link style (fd-link; data-quiet hides its underline until hover), single-line truncation and a two or three line clamp. They set colour and clipping, never size.
useWhen: A line is secondary: a hint, a timestamp, a caption.
A name must truncate with an ellipsis, or a description clamps to two or three lines.
A link sits inside a sentence.

avoidWhen.when: The text needs a size or weight.
A status needs a dot and a label.
A short label needs a fill.

variants.useWhen: A link that takes the body ink colour instead of the accent.
A link whose underline shows only on hover.

parts.role: The third-step colour for placeholders and decoration.
